items.name: clap-htsat-fused
items.summary: CLAP-HTSAT-fused是由LAION开发的音频-文本融合模型，结合了对比语言-音频预训练与HTSAT架构。该模型学习音频信号和文本描述之间的联合表示，实现跨模态理解。支持特征提取任务，兼容transformers框架。采用Apache 2.0许可证发布，适用于音频分类、检索以及需要音频和文本对齐的多模态学习应用场景。该模型能够处理音频与文本之间的语义关联任务。
items.summary_en: CLAP-HTSAT-fused is an audio-text fusion model developed by LAION that combines Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining with HTSAT architecture. The model learns joint representations between audio signals and text descriptions, enabling cross-modal understanding. It supports feature extraction tasks and is compatible with transformers framework. Released under Apache 2.0 license, the model facilitates applications in audio classification, retrieval, and multimodal learning where audio and text alignment is required.
